adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts the PR builds evt.destinationCalendar as an array and, for COLLECTIVE team events, pushes additional team members’ destination calendars (evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)). However, when persisting the booking it only connects the first element: `connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }`. Since later flows (confirm/cancel/payment/editLocation/requestReschedule) reconstruct `destinationCalendar` from `booking.destinationCalendar` (a single value) into a single-element array, any additional destination calendars added to the event at creation time are not persisted and cannot be retrieved for later operations, effectively losing them.
